fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Reduced-length collector-distributor weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak flow is a substantive, well-recognised preliminary-design motorway safety issue (concentrated lane-change demand elevating sideswipe/rear-end exposure), anchored to recorded geometry and volume inputs rather than speculation.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Geometry and volume claims rest on recorded input facts and EV-IN-004 is quoted verbatim, but the quote only evidences that PIARC motorway preliminary-design checklists exist, not that they cover weaving sections or that this weave is inadequate, so the pivotal claim lacks direct verbatim support.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern with null normative basis under the PIARC-derived INT preliminary-design baseline; HSM Part C/IHSDM are offered as optional evaluation tools rather than compliance requirements, keeping safety concerns and compliance questions categorically distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, staged and viable: screen via the PIARC preliminary-design motorway checklist, quantify with HSM Part C or IHSDM, then lengthen the CD weaving section or install entry ramp metering if inadequacy is flagged — concrete triggers and mitigations, not a null action.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU exposure is not applicable because the shared-use paths are grade-separated from the motorised weave, and the finding explicitly acknowledges and justifies this scoping, earning the acknowledgment-capped score.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled free-flow ramp-terminal crossings conflicting with recorded VRU-continuity objectives is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue for path users at the retained loops.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-IN-005 provides a verbatim quote directly supporting the pivotal audit-gap claim ('have pedestrian, cyclist... needs been accounted for?'), while the layout/objective claims tie to explicitly recorded input facts cited in the scenario.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: PIARC-derived international semantics respected: raised as a safety_concern distinct from compliance checks, with thematic-audit and all-road-users requirements correctly applied at int:preliminary-design stage.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable at preliminary design: named tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI), designated crossing treatments (signalised or grade-separated) at each identified shared-use path/ramp-terminal interface.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus with their exposure at ramp terminals fully considered; no other VRU-relevant aspect left unaddressed.
